descriptions.pendant-akoya-wg-diana: the classic diana setting, reimagined as a pendant — equally versatile with a simple tee or a tailored shirt. the first piece you'll reach for whenever you want to feel your best.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-classic: sometimes, less truly is more. a single pearl on a delicate gold chain, allowing the akoya's natural beauty to speak for itself — effortless with anything in your wardrobe, made for those who love simplicity.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-mermaid: one of our most beloved pieces — a pearl that falls like a mermaid's tear, catching the light against a smaller pearl above. refined, distinctive, and made for someone entirely her own.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-star: gold chain and pearl shine together in this versatile stellar necklace — beautiful with an open neckline, as if wearing the stars themselves. for those who love to catch the light.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-5.5mm: the soft grey-blue hue gives this pearl an instantly elevated look. 5.5mm strikes the perfect balance — understated, yet unmistakably present. beautiful with a dress, a shirt, or a simple tee, and even more striking layered with other necklaces.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-7.5mm: the most classic akoya necklace size — substantial enough to wear alone and make a statement. beautiful with an open neckline, especially in summer, and just as lovely over a simple camisole.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-8-8.5-q1: a single strand that does it all — luminous, full-bodied akoya pearls in a soft pink hue, rivaling any fine jewelry counter. whether for a wedding, a graduation, or any moment that matters, this necklace shines alongside you.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-y: our most beloved silhouette — the y-chain elongates the neckline and flatters the face beautifully. a single akoya pearl rests at the center, swaying gently with your movement and drawing the eye exactly where it should. the adjustable length allows for several ways to wear it.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-3.5: our summer favorite — an exquisitely refined strand of small akoya pearls. understated luxury worn alone, and effortlessly elevated when layered with other necklaces.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-8.5mm: a single strand that does it all — luminous, full-bodied akoya pearls rivaling any fine jewelry counter. whether for a wedding, a graduation, or any moment that matters, this necklace shines alongside you.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-candy-8.0: for anyone who's found pearls a little too formal — this macaron-hued strand brings a playful sweetness to the neckline, without compromising on the quality of a fine akoya pearl. a summer favorite.
descriptions.necklace-southsea-8.0-10.0: the south sea strand is the jewelry investment that never loses its worth — a necklace to treasure for a lifetime, and to pass down beyond it. at 8-10mm, it elevates any look, from a simple white tee to a gown. own it once, keep it forever.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-apple: a design both refined and playful — an 18K gold apple set with diamonds, cradling a luminous akoya pearl. unexpected, endearing, and entirely its own.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-flower: a south sea piece to own once and treasure always — a warm, lustrous white pearl paired with a striking gold pearl, framed by a gilded floral setting. the adjustable double-strand length allows for several ways to wear it — a truly distinctive long necklace.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-blue-y: the silver-blue south sea pearl is a rare find, set on a y-chain that elongates the neckline and flatters the face. as you move, the pearl sways gently, drawing the eye exactly where it should.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-rainbow-y: a south sea pearl with natural rainbow overtones is rare in itself — set on a y-chain, its color shifts with every movement. a piece that looks entirely different in every light.
descriptions.necklace-tahitian: no two multicolor tahitian necklaces are ever alike — that is precisely its beauty. black, grey, green, and peacock pearls, thoughtfully paired to complement one another. a collector's piece that draws admiration every time it's worn.
descriptions.pendant-tahitian-necklace: a single tahitian pearl on a delicate chain — deep, complex, endlessly captivating. for those drawn to depth and mystery rather than the expected.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-keshi: akoya keshi pearls carry all the luster of fine akoya with the freedom of organic form — each one a small marvel of nature. gathered together in a single strand, they become something truly special.
descriptions.necklace-bluebarouque: baroque south sea pearls in a cool blue-grey are a rare find — organic form and cool tone together create something sculptural rather than merely decorative. for those who truly wish to stand apart.
